learn.title: Learn Risk Management
learn.subtitle: A quick guide on why risk management matters and how this tool supports your trades.

points.capital: Protects capital: small, controlled losses keep you in the game.
points.consistency: Improves consistency: position sizing aligns risk across trades.
points.emotions: Reduces emotions: predefined risk limits remove impulsive decisions.
points.survivability: Increases survivability: avoids large drawdowns and account blowups.
points.compounding: Enables compounding: preserving equity lets winners compound over time.

points.position: Calculates position size from balance, risk %, and stop loss.
points.risk: Shows exact capital at risk so you never overexpose.
points.stoploss: Translates stop loss % into real dollar impact.
points.leverage: Accounts for leverage to size margin and total position.
points.rr: Visualizes Risk/Reward to estimate PnL, ROE, and impact.

points.journal: Keep a journal: log risk %, stop loss, and outcomes.
points.fixedRisk: Use fixed risk per trade (e.g., 0.5–2%) for discipline.
points.realistic: Set realistic R:R targets; focus on quality setups.
points.fees: Consider fees, slippage, and funding in your planning.

learn.disclaimer: This content is educational only and not financial advice.
